suite: Logos TPC-H, DSB, TPC-DS pairs (on data)
metric: Calcite (R-Bot) outputs and TPC-DS variants that return different rows from their source query on a database: the generated benchmark data or a small constraint-respecting database. They are label failures, kept as negatives that must never be proved.
correctness: Every difference repeats with DuckDB's optimizer off (run_unoptimized); a small database's difference also survives row shuffles; under a root LIMIT the rows differ with the LIMIT removed too
caveats: 3 pairs are separated by a small database, 1 on the generated data. Logos 333d5275ac87; query text fetched at run time, never committed. By family: rbot-tpch 16/21 proved, 1 refuted; rbot-dsb 18/36 proved, 1 refuted; tpcds-variants 2/12 proved, 2 refuted. 14 TPC-DS variant pairs are adapted (TOP n read as LIMIT n, date + n days as an interval): 2 proved, 2 refuted among them. TPC-H data is scale 0.1 (tpchgen-cli); TPC-DS data is scale 1 from DSB's dsdgen, whose distributions differ from the official kit's. The TPC-H schema declares no keys, so proofs hold over every database with its NOT NULL columns. Prover routes time out after 120 s of wall-clock time, so a loaded machine can turn a few proofs into timeouts. Baseline before any harness fix: 23/69 proved, 4 refuted, 0 wrong (5/11 held out). The two harness fixes (moving Calcite's derived-table column lists into the derived table with KumoSQL's expand_alias_columns, and one renamed TPC-DS column on the generated data) were made on the dev split, but the baseline listing showed every pair's failure reason, held-out ones included (tuned on test, exposure only; the held-out score did not move). Measured on master a481075; no prover change was made for this eval.
